description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPI class, which extends Endpoint and implements CollectionEndpoint. It provides an API endpoint for summarizing employee attendance data, including filtering by date ranges and employee number, with support for sorting and pagination. The class handles request parameter validation, permission checks, and retrieves attendance summaries through associated services. It is part of the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin's API namespace.
